name: Simple Baked Dory Fillet
instructions: Place the frozen Dory fillet on a baking tray.
Bake for 20 minutes until the fillet is cooked through and flakes easily.

name: Steamed Dory Fillet
instructions: Set up a steamer with water and bring to a boil.
Place the frozen Dory fillet in the steamer basket.
Steam for 12 minutes until the fillet is opaque and flakes with a fork.
